sourceCard.geometry: Fixed common outer box above note, clear of notebook metadata.
sourceCard.longText: Readable wrap/internal scroll, no form conversion or note shrinking.
sourceCard.practiceVariation: Readonly hints/audio/model visibility follow actual stage; no second editor.

notebookEditor.placement: Measured current sentence/current line on the physical A5 paper after committed lines.
notebookEditor.appearance: Transparent/no separate form frame, actual editable text/caret on a note rule.
notebookEditor.layout: Use shared A5 row plan, metrics and baseline. Reserve full active sentence rows before vocabulary/grammar; long drafts/confirmed text must not cover later blocks.
notebookEditor.focus: Keep stable editor identity/focus/selection/composition on theme/color/memo/timer changes.
notebookEditor.viewport: Follow active rule with scroll/readable zoom, keep previous lines accessible; do not shrink paper or font.
notebookEditor.feedback: Errors keep draft/current source and earlier committed content; actual validation follows learning logic.

confirmation.location: Desk margin next to notebook active line, outside paper; not on source card.
confirmation.label: 確認
confirmation.commit: Validate/save actual learner result first, then display handwriting at same line. No card-to-paper draft transfer, duplicate ink or animation-driven learning completion.
confirmation.advance: Follow existing deliberate learning flow; do not add auto-advance based on this visual comp.

state.presentationChanges: Do not clear/reset/remount editor when changing theme, color, timer visibility or memos.
